host_name.description: The name of this conductor node in the cluster.

conductor_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the conductor service.

bind_host.description: IP address on which the conductor API listens.

bind_port.description: Port on which the conductor API listens.

ca_file.description: Path to the CA certificate file used for TLS.

cert_file.description: Path to the server certificate file for TLS.

key_file.description: Path to the private key file for TLS.

enable_tls.description: Enable TLS for the conductor API.

database_connection.description: Database connection string for the backend.

keystone_admin_domain_name.description: Domain name for the Keystone admin user.

keystone_region_name.description: Region name for Keystone service catalog.

cert_manager.description: Name of the certificate manager backend (e.g., 'cert_manager' or 'local').

temp_dir.description: Directory for temporary certificates and artifacts.

cluster_template_defaults.description: List of default values for cluster template attributes.

default_docker_storage_driver.description: Default Docker storage driver to use for clusters.

transport_url.description: Message queue transport URL (e.g., RabbitMQ or Qpid).

trustee_domain_id.description: Domain ID where trustee users are created for delegated access.

trustee_domain_admin.description: Username of the trustee domain admin.

trustee_domain_admin_password.description: Password of the trustee domain admin.

ca_valid_time.description: Validity period (in days) of the CA certificate.

cert_valid_time.description: Validity period (in days) of cluster node certificates.

renew_time.description: Number of days before certificate expiry to trigger renewal.

cluster_create_timeout.description: Timeout (in minutes) for cluster creation operations.

enable_barbican.description: Enable use of Barbican as a secret backend for secure certificate/key storage.
